### Feature suggestion

The color of the site is determined by three custom properties, `theme-h`, `theme-s`, and `theme-l`, which are used to create a `hsl()` color declaration.

Modifying the `theme-h` custom property in the `:root` selector allows the entire site to adjusts its theme color. I think it would be fun to have a little input range slider that allows a visitor to tweak the color from 1 to 360°, and then store the value to local storage.

### Who would you like to work on this feature?
